# Human-centred AI seminar notes

## Consent

Participation consent is specific to the stated study purpose and can be
withdrawn. Withdrawal does not require the participant to provide a reason.

## Accessibility

Alternative text should communicate the information needed to understand an
image in context. Decorative images should not create repetitive announcements
for screen-reader users.

## Feedback

Formative feedback identifies a next learning step while work is still in
progress. A final score alone does not provide that guidance.

## Confidence

A model's confidence value is not evidence that its answer is factually
correct. Important claims still require source support and appropriate review.
